name: F. Alden Eaton
role: Manager and superintendent of the Custer Trail Cattle Co.
bio: F. Alden Eaton was manager of the Custer Trail Cattle Company when he called at the Cow Boy office in October 1884 (the paper printed his initial as J.), and in 1885 he signed the company's strayed-stock notices as superintendent. In October 1885 he and Will Dantz accompanied the first cattle shipped from Medora's new stock-yards to sell them at St. Paul. In December 1885 he returned from an eastern trip to Pittsburgh and Meadville.
